column1: # E00-S13 known gaps: kind<TAB>frozen name<TAB>owner and reason. Each line is tolerated until fixed; the test fails
# once a line is fixed (remove it then). Only the coordinator adds a line, with the owning story.

column3: build-android-bg-platform (:android:termux): the Flutter RUN_COMMAND result service has no native class yet (android/termux manifest note); a Termux result issued by the Flutter app before the update is dropped.

P12-SCHEDULES (:android:schedules): ScheduleWork cancels "oc.schedule.<profile>.<occurrence>", a name Flutter never enqueued; its ".alarm"/".fallback" work survives the update and runs the ScheduledPromptWorker shim (re-arm only, nothing sent) instead of being cancelled.
P12-SCHEDULES (:android:schedules): native profile deletion cancels only "oc.nschedule.<profile>", so Flutter-era work of a deleted profile is not cancelled by tag.
